script.description: Save a personal reminder only to Todo. Validate the title and optional YYYY-MM-DD due date. Reuse an identical active reminder instead of duplicating it. Report success only after persistence is confirmed.

title.name: Title
title.description: The reminder action, without introductory words. Keep meaningful details.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, resolved in Europe/Amsterdam.

sequence.if: {{ title is not defined or title is not string or not title | trim or title | length > 255 or (due_date is defined and due_date not in [none, ''] and (due_date is not string or not (due_date | regex_match('^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$')) or strptime(due_date, '%Y-%m-%d', none) is none)) }}

then.stop: The reminder needs a title and a valid due date.

variables.reminder_exists: {% set found = namespace(value=false) %}{% for item in existing_reminders['todo.todo']['items'] %}{% if item.summary | lower == title | trim | lower and (item.due | default('', true))[:10] == due_date | default('', true) %}{% set found.value = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ found.value }}

then.data: {{ {'item': title | trim, 'due_date': due_date} if due_date is defined and due_date else {'item': title | trim} }}

automation.description: Save explicit reminder phrases to Todo. Resolve today and tomorrow in the Home Assistant time zone. Confirm only a verified save.

variables.relative_day: {{ 'tomorrow' if spoken_reminder | regex_search('(?i)\\btomorrow$') else 'today' if spoken_reminder | regex_search('(?i)\\btoday$') else '' }}

variables.reminder_title: {{ spoken_reminder | regex_replace('(?i)\\s+(today|tomorrow)$', '') | trim if relative_day else spoken_reminder }}
variables.reminder_due: {{ (now() + timedelta(days=1 if relative_day == 'tomorrow' else 0)).date().isoformat() if relative_day else '' }}

actions.if: {{ save_result is defined and save_result.saved | default(false) }}

then.set_conversation_response: Saved: {{ save_result.title }}{% if save_result.due_date %}, due {{ save_result.due_date }}{% endif %}.

else.set_conversation_response: I could not confirm the save. Check the Todo list before trying again.
